name: Volume Relaxation
definition: A heuristic optimization strategy that relaxes the surface assumption in challenging regions (e.g., sub-pixel structures, directional materials) to use volumetric alpha blending, while keeping the rest of the scene as opaque surfaces.
summary: Volume Relaxation dynamically switches loss supervision per sample based on a local heuristic, allowing surface-based radiance fields to revert to volumetric alpha blending in challenging regions while retaining surface-like properties elsewhere.
